tex_content.html:
Proposition
[$\pi _1$ of a product]

↗ def:loop-and-pi1-set

1. ch1:1.12\group Fundamental Group

For path-connected $X,Y$, $\pi _1(X\times Y,(x_0,y_0))\cong \pi _1(X,x_0)\times \pi _1(Y,y_0)$.

Proof

\sketch Coordinate projections identify loops and homotopies in $X\times Y$ with pairs in $X$ and $Y$, and this bijection respects concatenation.

□
